en: Black-and-white postcard showing an interior view of a richly sculpted Romanesque-Gothic cathedral portal, with multiple archivolts filled with dense reliefs of biblical scenes and rows of elongated standing saints on tall columns. The photograph looks obliquely along the portal so that the carved figures and columns recede into the distance; the floor is a checkerboard pattern. In the lower left corner there is faint printed text indicating an institution name.
